description: Search metadata in the provider’s public feed catalog, without credentials. This searches feed names and descriptions, not post text, and does not enumerate every feed. Returns feeds in provider order with generator AT-URIs and creator identities; pass a feedUri to bsky_get_feed to read its posts. Uses app.bsky.unspecced.getPopularFeedGenerators, an unstable upstream API that may change or become unavailable. Continue with the returned opaque cursor and the same query.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response to this same query. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum feeds to return. Default 25; values above 100 are clamped with a notice unless read-limit clamping is disabled.

query.description: Feed catalog metadata to search, e.g. "science". Must not be blank.

name: bsky_search_feeds

cap.description: The limit applied to this page.

cursor.description: Opaque next-page cursor. Its presence signals continuation even when feeds is empty; absent at the end.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `catalog_unavailable`: The unstable upstream catalog endpoint is no longer available (HTTP 404 or 410). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

items.description: A feed generator in the public catalog.

creator.description: Identity of the account that created the feed.

did.description: Permanent DID of the feed creator.

description.description: Feed description supplied by its creator, when present.

displayName.description: Feed name supplied by its creator.

feedUri.description: Feed generator AT-URI; pass directly as feed to bsky_get_feed.

shown.description: Number of feeds returned on this page.

totalReturned.description: Number of feeds on this page.

truncated.description: True when a cursor is present, regardless of the number of feeds returned.

title: Search Bluesky Feeds
